$submissionId..validate: auth != null || (newData.hasChildren(['sessionId','plate','amount','txnRef','submittedAt','status']) && newData.child('txnRef').isString() && newData.child('txnRef').val().matches(/^[0-9]{12}$/) && newData.child('amount').isNumber() && newData.child('amount').val() >= 0 && newData.child('status').val() == 'pending_verification')
